critical_code_review_comments: server.py gen_invoice() and gen_purchase_no() both use count_documents()+1 - race-prone under concurrency; same note as iter-4. Low risk single-register.

POST /api/purchases has no auth-role restriction - any logged-in user (incl. kasir) can create purchases and update product cost. If intentional (one-register store), fine; else gate behind require_admin.
POST /api/expenses + DELETE /api/expenses/{id} allow any auth user - may want admin-only for financial integrity.
pay_transaction / pay_purchase don't reject amount<=0 or amount > sisa (silently clamped). Consider explicit 400 for amount<=0 to avoid empty payment entries in payments[] history.

Transaction stock decrement happens before discount validation; if items validation fails later, stock is already decremented. Current code has no late failures, but wrapping in a try/except with compensating update would be more robust.

Pengeluaran delete endpoint uses silent delete_one (no 404 if id missing). Minor consistency issue vs other DELETE endpoints which also silent-delete - acceptable but reduces visibility of client bugs.
No input validation that purchase.harga_beli/qty > 0 nor that expense.amount > 0; UI constrains it but backend should validate too (Pydantic Field(gt=0)).
/api/piutang + /api/hutang return full doc including ObjectId converted to id - OK no _id leak detected in testing.
